REMOVAL OF MASTER CYLINDER

CAUTION: Do not let brake fluid remain on a painted surface. Wash it off immediately.

1. DISCONNECT LEVEL WARNING SWITCH CONNECTOR

2. DISCONNECT TWO BRAKE TUBES
Using SST, disconnect two brake tubes from the master cylinder.
SST 09751-36011

3. REMOVE MASTER CYLINDER
(a) Remove the four nuts.
(b) Remove the master cylinder and gasket from the brake booster.

DISASSEMBLY OF MASTER CYLINDER

1. PLACE CYLINDER IN VISE

2. DISCONNECT RESERVOIR AND HOSE
Remove the cap, strainer, bolt and hose.

3. REMOVE SNAP RING AND ELBOW

4. REMOVE TWO OUTLET PLUGS

SST
